Name: UI Info Suite 2 Alternative
Author: dazuki
Description:
[center][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dazuki/UIInfoSuite2Alt/main/.github/assets/ui-info-suite-2-alternative-logo.png[/img][/center]
[center][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dazuki/UIInfoSuite2Alt/main/.github/assets/showcase-animation-2-compressed.webp[/img][/center]
[center]This is an alternative fork of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7098]UI Info Suite 2[/url] with additional features and bug fixes.[/center]


[size=4][b]Why Alternative?[/b][/size]
Since upstream development has slowed, this fork aims to keep the mod alive by fixing outstanding issues and adding features that felt missing. All credit for the mod goes to them.

Thanks to [url=https://github.com/Annosz]Annosz[/url], [url=https://github.com/tqdv]tqdv[/url], [url=https://github.com/drewhoener]drewhoener[/url], [url=https://github.com/cdaragorn]cdaragorn[/url] and all the contributors who built and maintained original UI Info Suite 2 over the years. Their work made this mod what it is today.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dazuki/UIInfoSuite2Alt/main/.github/assets/list-of-features.png[/img]

[size=4][b]Icons and Indicators[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Custom luck icon with multiple visual styles (Clover, Dice, TV Fortune) and option to require watching TV to reveal it[/*]
[*]Festival/Event reminder icon showing start and end times[/*]
[*]Crane Game icon showing when the Movie Theater minigame is available[/*]
[*]Traveling Merchant icon pulses when she's selling items needed for bundles (including Unlockable Bundles)[/*]
[*]Extra icons: Bookseller visits, Beach forage days (Summer), Pot of Gold / Rainbow, Ridgeside Village Traveling Merchant[/*]
[*]Mailbox letter count bubble[/*]
[*]Golden Walnut tracker showing collection progress by area on hover[/*]
[*]Tool upgrade icon works with modded tools[/*]
[*]Buff expiry sound and countdown timers below buff icons, with an option to shrink the top-right buff icons or hide them entirely[/*]
[*]Quest count under journal icon and daily quest exclamation mark on Billboard, plus a flashing clock when a quest or Special Order is on its last day[/*]
[*]Queen of Sauce recipe icon and Animal Husbandry Meat Friday recipe icon[/*]
[*]Special Orders & Qi Special Orders icons in inventory with animated exclamation marks[/*]
[*]Stacked birthday icons when multiple villagers share a birthday[/*]
[*]Show loved birthday gifts directly on the icon tooltip[/*]
[*]Item quality star shown on pickup notifications[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]HUD Layout[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Icons wrap to multiple rows/columns with configurable limit (1-10) and vertical stacking option[/*]
[*]Customizable icon sort order[/*]
[*]Full gamepad navigation for all HUD and inventory icons[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Experience Bar[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Mastery experience bar when all skills reach level 10[/*]
[*]XP combo counter that stacks gains while the bar is visible[/*]
[*]Support for modded skills (SpaceCore) with matching icons and colors, extended levels (Vanilla Plus Professions)[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Fishing[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Always show which fish you're reeling in (like having a Sonar Bobber without needing one)[/*]
[*]Quality star overlay on the fish icon with real-time perfect catch tracking[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Tooltips and Item Info[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Item icons on world tooltips[/*]
[*]Color-coded crop tooltips with harvest quality prediction[/*]
[*]Bundle icon on bundle item tooltips, Museum/Aquarium donation indicators on item tooltips (Vanilla + CMF + SBV)[/*]
[*]Garbage can tooltip showing today's contents (with Binning Skill level gating and Garbage Day chest contents)[/*]
[*]Fish pond tooltip showing population, spawn timing, quest status, and species icon[/*]
[*]Animal building tooltip showing animal count, with a hold-keybind detail view for pet status, produce readiness, golden cracker status, and overnight floor items[/*]
[*]Machine processing icon showing what's currently being made (with keybind toggle)[/*]
[*]Artifact spot tooltip showing predicted drops and ground mineral info[/*]
[*]Cask tooltip showing aging progress per quality level[/*]
[*]Artisan good sell prices shown on item hover tooltips[/*]
[*]Optionally gate sell/stack/artisan prices and shop harvest prices behind reading the Price Catalogue[/*]
[*]Skull Cavern hole tooltip showing destination floor, fall distance, and predicted HP damage[/*]
[*]Collection tab/Shipping bin icon for items needed in the Full Shipment collection[/*]
[*]Walk of Life sale bonus shown on item hover tooltips (Angler/Producer professions)[/*]
[*]Live score overlay during the Stardew Valley Fair grange display with prize info[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Item Range Display[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Reworked range highlights with keybinds and a tooltip showing tile coverage stats[/*]
[*]Smarter highlighting - Shows placeable and overlapping colored tiles[/*]
[*]Wild tree seed spread range on farms[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Menus and Keybinds[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Special Orders Board (J) - Board selectors for expansion mods (Ridgeside Village, Sunberry Village, Visit Mount Vapius, Sword & Sorcery and more in the future)[/*]
[*]Hide Trees keybind (F7) - Temporarily minimizes all trees making it easier to see your farm when large tree farms block the view (spot spawned seeds, etc.)[/*]
[*]Other Keybinds: Monster Eradication Goals (F9), Mod Options Tab (F8)[/*]
[*]"Open GMCM Options" button and custom tab icon on the in-game options tab[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Settings[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Single global config file with full GMCM (Generic Mod Config Menu) support[/*]
[*]Organized multi-page GMCM layout and collapsible sections in the in-game options tab[/*]
[*]More fine-tuned control: separate toggles for crops/trees, world/inventory tooltips, machine timers, bomb range and more[/*]
[/list]

[size=4]... and more that I probably forgot to list![/size]
